summary.name: Help desk software
summary.one_liner: Wikipedia article describing help desk software, a program that lets customer-care operators track user requests and handle related support issues.
use_cases: building a FAQ or knowledge base
comparing cloud and on-premises help desk options
summary.what_it_does: This Wikipedia article explains what help desk software is and how it fits within the service desk category alongside asset management and IT service management. It describes the typical parts of such software: ticket management, an automation suite, and reporting/optimization. It also covers common features such as a contact point for customers, a ticketing system, a knowledge base, dashboards, analytics, escalation, and chat. The page additionally gives a brief history from face-to-face service through telephone, email, and the 2000s-era platforms, and lists benefits and disadvantages.
notable: Explains help desk software as part of the broader service desk category
Covers benefits such as automated ticket categorization and routing
Notes cloud vs on-premises cost and availability trade-offs
caveats: Describes a product category rather than a specific tool, so it names no software to install
Some cited sources are from 2014-2016 and may be dated
